content: Optional existence of reference VariationPointProxy . implementationDataType if the bindingTime is set to preCompileTime If the value of attribute bindingTime of VariationPointProxy . valueAccess is set to the value preCompileTime , then the creation of a reference to an Implementa- tionDataType in the role VariationPointProxy . implementationDataType shall be taken to determine the suffix to qualify the numerical value yielded from the formula expression for the creation of a preprocessor macro.
